items.fact: IASST Guwahati (DST autonomous; Prof. Ashis K. Mukherjee) equine F(ab')2 bivalent antivenom against red-tailed bamboo pit viper and Pope's pit viper (Mizoram, Meghalaya); better preclinical protection than Indian polyvalent (Big Four) antivenom.

items.label: Writ of prohibition — stops a lower court/tribunal before decision (certiorari quashes after)
items.fact: Prohibition issued by a superior court to a lower court/tribunal to stop proceedings in excess of jurisdiction while pending; certiorari quashes a decision already made.

items.label: Art 356(5) — President's Rule beyond one year only with National Emergency + EC certificate (44th Am.)
items.fact: Art 356(5): resolution continuing President's Rule beyond one year only if National Emergency in operation in India/the State and EC certifies Assembly elections cannot be held; overall max 3 years.
